questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Which one of the following statements is FALSE?
options: More than $80 \%$ of the solar energy incident on earth is captured by plants and photosynthetic bacteria.
Only $10 \%$ of energy is transferred to each of the higher trophic levels in grazing food chain.
All organisms of a trophic level should be included for estimation of energy content of that trophic level.
The movement of energy is unidirectional in the ecological pyramid of energy.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: The following word diagram depicts a food chain in a forest.$\text{ Trees (Aspen, willow) } \longrightarrow \text{ Herbivore (Elk) } \longrightarrow \text{ Predator (Wolf) } Which is the most likely outcome of depletion in predator population?$
options: No change in the ecosystem as the herbivore and the tree populations will continue to maintain equilibrium
Overgrowth of herbivore population without any change in the remaining part of the ecosystem
Overgrowth of herbivore population causing reduction in tree populations and therefore, if the process continues the entire ecosystem will breakdown
Increased browsing by the herbivores stimulates the plant growth leading to increased primary productivity
